n8cc40a55b5.headline: Gross profit of Chvaletice power plant increased significantly
n8cc40a55b5.summary: The Chvaletice power plant generated a pre-tax profit of approximately 488 million crowns last year, recovering from a loss in 2016 due to shutdowns and fire damage.
n8cc40a55b5.why: Improved profitability at a major Czech power plant signals operational recovery and impacts the energy sector.

nd35ad23037.headline: The average price of a new smartphone in the Czech Republic rose to 6,900 crowns, new figures show | Aktuálně.cz
nd35ad23037.summary: The average price for a new smartphone in the Czech Republic increased to 6,900 crowns, with annual mobile phone sales exceeding 3.5 million units and single-digit market growth last year.
nd35ad23037.why: Smartphone pricing trends reflect consumer demand, technology adoption, and economic conditions in the Czech Republic's consumer electronics market.
